intent: Preserve detailed Style 2 scene information while applying Style 3 rendering

jobs.title: Daan · Annapurna and Shiva
jobs.details: Retain Shiva seated left offering his bowl, Annapurna seated right ladling rice from the gold vessel, Nandi behind Shiva, Shiva's trident/drum/crescent/snake and tiger-pattern cloth, Annapurna's crown/halo/jewellery/red-and-green sari, the offering's hand-to-ladle-to-bowl relationship, temple columns and carvings, brass bell, shrine with its small existing Om symbol, lit brass standing lamp, rice/fruit/food vessels and cloth, river boats, Kashi ghats and distant temples, overhead tree leaves, stone paving and petals. Both principal figures have exactly two anatomically connected arms; keep the original hands/feet.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: compact devotional reader illustration, opaque 2:1 horizontal banner.
Primary request: EDIT IMAGE 1. Retain its complete detailed scene and composition; apply only the painted rendering language of images 2 and 3 (the app's Krishna storybook illustrations).
Input roles: image 1 is the edit target and authoritative composition/detail reference. Images 2 and 3 are STYLE ONLY, never sources of characters, props, setting, framing or portrait dimensions.
Rendering: precise fine warm-brown outlines, graceful expressive faces, muted yet legible pastel colours, soft layered hand-painted shading, matte gold, subtle warm paper grain. Keep all objects and fine craftsmanship readable. Storybook painting can be richly detailed. Do not flatten or simplify the architecture, vegetation, cloth/jewellery patterns or narrative information. Preserve tonal separation, clarity and depth, without a heavy sepia wash.
Invariants: preserve image 1's exact 2:1 horizontal framing, view angle, relative placement, scale, poses, gestures, facial directions, relationships, foreground/middle-ground/background, complete figures and all significant scene details. Transfer colour/brushwork/shading only. No zoom, recomposition, crop, added blank band, UI, caption, border or watermark. No new characters or iconography. Do not copy the portrait blank parchment bands of the style references.

Scene-specific preservation checklist: Retain Shiva seated left offering his bowl, Annapurna seated right ladling rice from the gold vessel, Nandi behind Shiva, Shiva's trident/drum/crescent/snake and tiger-pattern cloth, Annapurna's crown/halo/jewellery/red-and-green sari, the offering's hand-to-ladle-to-bowl relationship, temple columns and carvings, brass bell, shrine with its small existing Om symbol, lit brass standing lamp, rice/fruit/food vessels and cloth, river boats, Kashi ghats and distant temples, overhead tree leaves, stone paving and petals. Both principal figures have exactly two anatomically connected arms; keep the original hands/feet.

jobs.title: Sundarkand · Hanuman and Sita
jobs.details: Retain Hanuman kneeling left with palms joined facing Sita right, his expressive monkey face, crown, jewellery, red shawl, entire curling tail and feet. Retain Sita's seated pose on stone, downward gaze, two hands resting on her lap, cream sari with fine gold border, veil, ornaments and full feet. Keep the large Ashoka trunk/right canopy and red-orange hanging blossoms, basket of white flowers, red seat cloth, lotus pond with lily pads/flowers, stone garden wall, left pavilion, tall trees, distant hills, layered flowering shrubs and individual foreground flowers, stone/sand garden path and fallen petals. Keep both figures' exact original poses/proportions and the original richly detailed garden.

jobs.title: Gita · Vishvarupa
jobs.details: Retain the entire original cosmic Vishvarupa scene: Arjuna kneeling in reverence left, ornate chariot/wheel/canopy/red flag and white horses behind him; the central blue-faced cosmic form with all of the target's crown/halo, surrounding crowned heads, radiating individually connected arms and existing handheld symbols/objects, blessing hand, gold/yellow garments, green/red cloth and flower garlands, complete feet.
